# How Much Does an iPhone 13 Cost in 2026? Used Prices

Apple stopped selling the iPhone 13 in September 2024, but it is still one of the most popular iPhones on Swappa. This guide shows what the iPhone 13 costs right now, model by model, by storage and carrier, and whether it is still a smart buy in 2026.

Table of Contents

## Quick Answer

A used **iPhone 13** averages about **$293** on Swappa, with listings starting around **$134**. The **iPhone 13 mini** averages about **$289**, the **iPhone 13 Pro** about **$437**, and the **iPhone 13 Pro Max** about **$485**. The most common configuration, unlocked with 128GB, averages about **$287**. Prices are Swappa averages as of September 23, 2026, and they change weekly, so check the live [iPhone 13 price page](https://swappa.com/prices/apple-iphone-13) before you buy.

## iPhone 13 Prices on Swappa by Model

| Model | Launch price (base storage) | Starting price on Swappa | Average price on Swappa |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [iPhone 13 mini](https://swappa.com/listings/apple-iphone-13-mini) | $699 | About $165 | About $289 |
| [iPhone 13](https://swappa.com/listings/apple-iphone-13) | $799 | About $134 | About $293 |
| [iPhone 13 Pro](https://swappa.com/listings/apple-iphone-13-pro) | $999 | About $258 | About $437 |
| [iPhone 13 Pro Max](https://swappa.com/listings/apple-iphone-13-pro-max) | $1,099 | About $309 | About $485 |

Swappa prices as of September 23, 2026, across all conditions, carriers, and storage sizes. The starting price is usually a Fair-condition or carrier-locked listing.

The iPhone 13 mini holds its value unusually well. It was the last small flagship Apple made, so compact-phone fans keep demand high, and it often costs about the same as the larger iPhone 13.

## Used iPhone 13 Prices by Storage and Carrier

For the standard iPhone 13, here is how configuration changes the price, alongside the trade-in quote Swappa’s price page shows for the same configuration:

| Carrier and storage | Active listings | Average sale price | Trade-in quote |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unlocked, 128GB | 159 | About $287 | About $131 |
| AT&T, 128GB | 61 | About $254 | About $110 |
| Verizon, 128GB | 28 | About $316 | About $107 |
| T-Mobile, 128GB | 27 | About $295 | About $97 |
| Unlocked, 256GB | 25 | About $305 | About $153 |
| Unlocked, 512GB | 19 | About $375 | About $162 |

Swappa data as of September 23, 2026. Averages for configurations with few listings move more from week to week.

Two patterns stand out. Unlocked 128GB has by far the most listings, which keeps its prices competitive. And stepping up to 256GB costs surprisingly little right now, often less than $25 more on average for unlocked models.

## What Changes the Price of a Used iPhone 13

**[Shop Used iPhone 13 Listings on Swappa](https://swappa.com/listings/apple-iphone-13)**

## Should You Buy an iPhone 13 at These Prices?

For most budget buyers, yes. The iPhone 13 has the A15 Bionic chip, a sharp OLED display, 5G, MagSafe, Face ID, and a dual camera with Night mode and Cinematic mode, and it runs iOS 27. Released in 2021, it sits well inside Apple’s typical six-to-eight-year support window, so it should keep getting updates for a few more years.

What you give up:

Here is how the iPhone 13 compares with the phones around it on price:

| Model | Average used price on Swappa | Worth knowing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [iPhone SE (3rd gen)](https://swappa.com/listings/apple-iphone-se-3rd-gen-2022) | About $150 | Same A15 chip in a small 4.7-inch body with Touch ID |
| [iPhone 12](https://swappa.com/listings/apple-iphone-12) | About $231 | Similar design, one year older, likely the next to lose updates |
| **iPhone 13** | **About $293** | The sweet spot of price and remaining support |
| [iPhone 14](https://swappa.com/listings/apple-iphone-14) | About $350 | Adds satellite SOS and Crash Detection; eSIM-only in the US |
| [iPhone 16e](https://swappa.com/listings/apple-iphone-16e) | About $428 | USB-C and Apple Intelligence, single rear camera |

Swappa averages as of September 23, 2026. For the full budget picture, see [Best Cheap iPhones in 2026: Top Picks Under $300](https://www.swappa.com/blog/best-cheap-iphone), which names the iPhone 13 its best overall pick.

## iPhone 13 vs. 13 mini vs. 13 Pro vs. 13 Pro Max

All four share the A15 Bionic chip, 5G, MagSafe, Face ID, and a Lightning port.

|  | iPhone 13 mini | iPhone 13 | iPhone 13 Pro | iPhone 13 Pro Max |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | 5.4-inch OLED | 6.1-inch OLED | 6.1-inch OLED, 120Hz ProMotion | 6.7-inch OLED, 120Hz ProMotion |
| Rear cameras | 12MP wide and ultra wide | 12MP wide and ultra wide | Wide, ultra wide, 3x telephoto, LiDAR | Wide, ultra wide, 3x telephoto, LiDAR |
| Storage | 128GB to 512GB | 128GB to 512GB | 128GB to 1TB | 128GB to 1TB |
| Video playback (Apple rating) | Up to 17 hours | Up to 19 hours | Up to 22 hours | Up to 28 hours |

The standard iPhone 13 is the best value for most people. Choose the mini for one-handed use, the 13 Pro for the telephoto lens and smoother 120Hz screen, and the 13 Pro Max if battery life matters most. For a deeper side-by-side, see [iPhone 13 vs 13 Pro: Which iPhone 13 Should You Buy in 2026?](https://www.swappa.com/blog/iphone-13-vs-13-pro-which-iphone-13-should-i-buy), and if you are also weighing the older model, [iPhone 12 vs iPhone 13: Which Should You Buy Used in 2026?](https://www.swappa.com/blog/apple-iphone-12-vs-iphone-13-which-should-you-buy)

## iPhone 13 Launch Prices and Price History

Apple released the iPhone 13 lineup in September 2021 at these prices:

| Model | 128GB | 256GB | 512GB | 1TB |

| iPhone 13 | $799 | $899 | $1,099 | Not offered |
| iPhone 13 Pro | $999 | $1,099 | $1,299 | $1,499 |
| iPhone 13 Pro Max | $1,099 | $1,199 | $1,399 | $1,59
